facts.text: Westcliff offers a Civil Servant Scholarship with a 20% tuition discount and application fee waiver for domestic students working in U.S. civil services, including school educators and first responders.

sources.title: Scholarships and Grants | Westcliff University
sources.quote: Civil Servant Scholarship Established to support new domestic students employed in U.S. civil services. Scholarship Criteria: Award amount: 20% tuition discount Application fee waiver Eligible populations include educators, school district employees, federal employees
